title: fix(ui): reconnect cross-browser F2 continuations to their origin row
context:
f2EffectiveParentSessionId only found a continuation's newer session
via a localStorage edge recorded in the SAME browser that clicked
"Continue in a new session". When that happened elsewhere, the old
origin session never learned a newer session continued from it and
rendered as an orphaned standalone row -- even though the new
session's own provenance chip already linked back to it, showing the
same relationship twice, disconnected instead of nested (CCC-927).

Now falls back to scanning loade
